resolution: The q.75 first subconclusion is not being a body. The existing q.14 highest-immateriality antecedent additionally denies matter/form composition and componenthood; neither follows here. Q.75 a.2 ad 1–2 and q.76 a.1 preserve that the soul is a part/form of human nature, while the complete human being is the composite. No bridge to the divine HasIntellect argument or to STMT-IMMATERIAL-IS-INTELLECTUAL is advertised.
